name: United States
intro: Explore the diverse landscapes of the United States. From the soaring skyscrapers of Manhattan to the massive sandstone canyons of Utah, the USA is a continent-spanning journey.
bestSeason: September to November (Autumn foliage) & April to June (Spring)
weather: Diverse climate. Warm sunny days in California, hot dry desert sun in Utah, and snowy cold winters in the northern states.
visaInfo: Tourist visa required for Indian passport holders prior to arrival.
flightDuration: Approx 15-18 hours flight from major Indian airports.
highlights: Fly by private helicopter over the Manhattan skyline in New York
Gaze at the massive red rock walls of the Grand Canyon
Drive a luxury convertible along the Pacific Coast Highway in California
Stay in architectural desert retreats in Canyon Point, Utah

famousPlaces.name: New York Skyline
famousPlaces.shortDesc: The center of global finance, media, and culture, defined by Central Park and Broadway lights.
famousPlaces.overview: New York City is a global icon. Walk the pathways of Central Park, see a Broadway show, and take a private helicopter tour over the Hudson River and the Statue of Liberty.
famousPlaces.bestTimeToVisit: September to November, April to June

hotels.name: The Plaza Hotel
hotels.description: Legendary luxury hotel located at Fifth Avenue and Central Park South.

famousPlaces.meals: Classic New York breakfasts and gourmet dining at high-rise restaurants.
famousPlaces.transport: Private limousine transfers and NYC subway passes.
famousPlaces.activities: Helicopter Skyline Flight, Broadway Front-Row Seats, Empire State Observatory VIP Pass.

faqs.a: Yes, we secure premium front-row or box seats in advance for major Broadway shows.

reviews.author: Anish M.
reviews.text: The helicopter ride over Manhattan at night was spectacular. The lights are endless.

itinerary.title: Welcome to NYC & Central Park Walk
itinerary.morning: Airport pickup in luxury limousine, check into The Plaza. Rest.
itinerary.afternoon: Stroll the paths of Central Park and visit Bethesda Fountain.
itinerary.evening: Enjoy dinner overlooking the park skyline.

itinerary.title: Manhattan Helicopter & Broadway Show
itinerary.morning: Fly by private helicopter over the Hudson River and Statue of Liberty.
itinerary.afternoon: Shop on Fifth Avenue and visit Times Square.
itinerary.evening: Pre-theatre dinner followed by a premium Broadway show.
